items.title: Terri Lyne Carrington interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: So once I really developed the interest I went back to Robin and, you know, tell me more. And he took me when I received Gohonzon

ctx.x: Was your interest in Buddhism, did it have anything to do with music or meeting people through music?

Yes. Robin Eubanks always talked to me about Buddhism but when I met Wayne Shorter he really got me into the practice. He lived in California and Robin lived in New York and I was living in New York at the time. So once I really developed the interest I went back to Robin and, you know, tell me more. And he took me when I received Gohonzon which is a scroll that is used as like an object of worship.
